verification.title: Automatic join verification
verification.summary: Controls whether the bot starts automatic verification for new join requests and new members.
verification.enabled: New join requests enter automatic verification, and eligible members who join directly also receive a challenge.
verification.disabled: New join requests remain for administrators to review manually, and newly joined members receive no challenge; verifications already in progress continue.

antispam.title: Sender-channel impersonation protection
antispam.summary: Controls whether the bot intercepts posts sent through untrusted channel identities.
antispam.enabled: When BotFather privacy mode is off, posts from untrusted channel identities are deleted; after confirming the sender is not the group's linked channel, that sender identity is banned and the moderation log is notified.
antispam.disabled: The bot does not inspect sender-channel identities, and those messages continue through normal processing.
